video_title: Zion Williamson reacts to Pelicans loss vs. Nets

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson calls recent Pelicans performance unacceptable
quotes.excerpt: Unacceptable. I don't have a lot of words. Just unacceptable.
quotes.quote: Unacceptable. I don't have a lot of words. Just unacceptable.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson calls for team-wide accountability after losses
quotes.excerpt: You have to go look yourself in the mirror when you buy yourself and say did I do everything
quotes.quote: As men, we have to, as a unit, players, coaches, everybody, you have to go look yourself in the mirror when you buy yourself and say did I do everything that I needed to do for my team? Was I in the gaps on defense? Was I the low man when I was supposed to? Did I get out there and contest shots to make it tough on them? Did I do everything I needed to do? Did I give it a real effort? That's what everybody has to do.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson addresses low team energy and recent losses
quotes.excerpt: I'm sitting like this here tonight. The energy feels really low.
quotes.quote: I'm sitting like this here tonight. The energy feels really low. Past two, three games haven't been what we wanted. You're giving up that many points, but we come here Friday, Saturday, get both wins. The energy is going to be different. It's an 82-game season, but as far as tonight and what's been happening past two, three games, it's just unacceptable.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson emphasizes internal accountability over film study
quotes.excerpt: We have to start with ourselves first, looking in the mirror and say did I do what I needed
quotes.quote: We're together in the locker room. It's just, like I said, nobody likes to lose like this, but if we don't like to lose like this, we have to start with ourselves first, looking in the mirror and say did I do what I needed to do for my team? Not individually, did I do what I needed to do for my team? And then we go from there. We'll watch film, stuff like that, but it starts internally first.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on his aggressive approach to the Nets game
quotes.excerpt: They were trying to load up the paint, so for me attacking the gaps, finding shooters
quotes.quote: They were trying to load up the paint, so for me attacking the gaps, finding shooters, just trying to get some type of movement, some energy going for us. But you know the result just didn't go like that. In third quarter, defensively we held them to 24, but we only had 15. And then the fourth quarter for them to have 38, it's not going to do us no good. It's just the reality of it.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson urges teammates to remember the feeling of losing
quotes.excerpt: Just remember this feeling. If you don't like feeling like this after a game
quotes.quote: Just remember this feeling. If you don't like feeling like this after a game, if you don't like going home like this, like that's what takes me back to the you got to look in the mirror and say did I do what I needed to do for my team? And if you feel like you can't say that, what can I change? What can I do better? Go ask the coaches, coaches can ask players, whatever it is, like because nobody likes to feel like this. Nobody wants to lose like this. It's unacceptable.

quotes.speaker: Zion Williamson
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson on the importance of self-accountability for leaders
quotes.excerpt: When you give self-accountability first, the message comes off a lot clear and people are more receptive
quotes.quote: It starts with us. Whenever you're trying to get a message across, when you give self-accountability first, the message comes off a lot clear and people are more receptive to the message versus going in somewhere and saying I feel like you could have did this, I feel like you could have did that. No. You start with yourself. I could have did this better for the team. And then you just go around the room.
